meta.name: pdf-processing-pro
meta.description: Production-ready PDF processing with forms, tables, OCR, validation, and batch operations. Use when working with complex PDF workflows in production environments, processing large volumes of PDFs, or requiring robust error handling and validation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 批量处理PDF表单、表格、OCR和验证
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要自动化处理大量PDF文档
copy.tagline_en: Process PDF forms, tables, OCR, and validation in batch
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to automate processing of large volumes of PDFs

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以用内置脚本处理 PDF:分析并填写表单、提取表格和文字、OCR 识别扫描件、合并拆分 PDF,并在出错时给出明确提示。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理 PDF 相关的任务时,比如解析表单、提取表格、扫描件识别或批量操作,就会触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个PDF的表单结构
say.note: 运行 analyze_form 脚本输出字段信息

say.text: 把这份报表里的表格提取成CSV
say.note: 运行 extract_tables 脚本导出表格

say.text: 批量提取这个文件夹里所有PDF的文字
say.note: 用批处理脚本逐个处理并报告结果

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can use built-in scripts to process PDFs: analyze and fill forms, extract tables and text, OCR scanned files, merge and split PDFs, and report errors clearly.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for PDF-related tasks, such as parsing forms, extracting tables, OCR of scanned files, or batch processing.

say_en.text: Analyze the form structure of this PDF.
say_en.note: Runs analyze_form script to output field info.

say_en.text: Extract the tables from this report to CSV.
say_en.note: Runs extract_tables script to export tables.

say_en.text: Batch extract text from all PDFs in this folder.
say_en.note: Processes each file with batch script and reports.
